text:
tess (Demand Gen): Quick check — partner co-marketing play for CloudMart listing + joint webinar. Need final on registration routing and post-webinar nurture.
omar (Partnerships): CloudMart wants a single registration flow and a co-branded one-pager. They can share a customer quote.
kai (Content): I'll draft the webinar abstract + 1-pager. Keep methodology short for the benchmark excerpt.
lina (Marketing Ops): Routing plan: if `partner=cloudmart` then tag in HubSpot list `cloudmart_regs`, hidden field `partner=cloudmart`. Role-based routing: Eng -> Product SDR, Exec -> AE. Private checkbox -> enterprise tag + notify #eng-sre.
tess (Demand Gen): Promotion: blog publish Mon, webinar Wed. Email cadence: invite, reminder, day-of. Post: recording + 1-pager + CTA to schedule co-demo.
omar (Partnerships): Can CloudMart host the registration? They prefer, but must POST leads to our webhook. Lina?
lina (Marketing Ops): Yes — send them webhook spec. We require `email`, `name`, `company`, `partner`. Shared secret for verification.
ops-bot: Created webhook endpoint /marketing/partner-registrations. Secret pending.
kai (Content): Creative needs: co-branded header SVG, short bio from partner, and a quote. I'll mock the 1-pager in Figma.
tess (Demand Gen): Budget ask for retargeting: $800. Nate (AdOps) will confirm creative sizes.
omar (Partnerships): Partner wants embargo lifted Wed 8am PT. OK with timeline?
tess (Demand Gen): Works for me. Action items: Lina send webhook spec, Kai draft content, Omar collect assets, Tess set up email cadences. Check-in tomorrow 11am PT. :thumbsup:
